name: mable
description: Publish the HTML games your AI makes as playable links, generate game assets, manage drafts and versions, and see how your games are played.

interface.longDescription:
Mable turns the HTML games you make with ChatGPT into a link anyone can play.

Ask for a small game and to publish it on Mable: the game is checked on a phone-sized screen (or a 1280x720 desktop window), problems are explained with how to fix them, and you see a publishing summary before anything goes live. You get a link to share with friends, or you can make the game public in the Mable community after a quick review.

Keep improving the same game: save private drafts that only you can try, publish a new version when you are happy, go back to an earlier version, or take a game offline. Every version records what changed.

Make game assets with Mable: sprite animations from your character art, visual effects, sound effects, music, voice lines and 3D models. Asset generation uses the Mable credits in your account; checking, publishing and stats are free.

See how each game is doing: players, how many played for 30 seconds or more, returning players and play time, with a suggestion for what to improve next.
defaultPrompt: Make a phone game where you tap falling stars, then publish it on Mable
How many people played my Mable games this week?
Make a looping background music track for my puzzle game

positive.description: Build and publish a new phone game as a link for friends
positive.prompt: Make a small phone game where you tap falling stars for 30 seconds and publish it on Mable as a link for my friends.
positive.expected_behavior: The game is checked first. The first publish_game call returns a summary and publishes nothing; after the user agrees, the game is published link-only and a playable mable.gg link is returned.

positive.description: Read play stats for the user's games
positive.prompt: Which of my Mable games had the most players this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's games and reports players, 30-second plays and returning players for the top game, with one suggestion.

positive.description: Save a private draft without changing the live game
positive.prompt: In my Mable game, change the timer to 60 seconds and save it as a draft so I can try it first.
positive.expected_behavior: The change is saved as a new private draft version and a preview link only the user can open is returned; players still see the live version.

positive.prompt: Go back to the previous version of my latest Mable game.
positive.expected_behavior: The earlier version is copied into a new draft version; history is kept and the live game is unchanged until the user publishes it.

positive.description: Generate background music for a game
positive.prompt: Make a calm looping background music track for my puzzle game.
positive.expected_behavior: A music job is started and polled until it finishes; a downloadable audio file is returned.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.
Write a short thank-you note to my teacher.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish AI-made HTML games as playable links, manage drafts and versions, generate game assets, and read play stats.
